field_verifications.evidence_text:
Serum Samples and Antibody Titer Measurements
Whole blood (10 mL) was collected in Vacutainer Serum Separator Tubes (Beckton-Dickinson). Serum was separated by centrifugation prior to storage at 220C. Hemagglutination inhibition (HAI) tests were performed as previously described [20], except for a starting serum sample dilution of 1:4 and the use of turkey red blood cells (RBCs). HAI test antigens were allantoic fluid harvests from infected embryonated hen’s eggs (whole virus antigens). Neutralizing antibody tests were performed as previously described [21] except that hamster serum was not included.
